def fit(cols,names):

    r=np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    print(names, np.round(c,4), r)

import numpy as np
def sc(cols):
    A=np.column_stack(cols); c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), np.round(c,4)
